sources.fact: Current authoritative Brownfield entity is LBBD60/DP, Abbey Retail Park (Former Sainsbury's Scheme), Abbey Road, Barking.
The current record gives 1,089 minimum and maximum net dwellings on 2.1ha.
The current record is permissioned with full-planning-permission dated 7 January 2020 and notes Development commenced.
The current record marks the site deliverable.
Ownership-status is not-owned-by-a-public-authority; this category is not a current named proprietor/title relation.
The Brownfield record supplies a point and blank geometry rather than an exact title or application polygon.

The June 2019 Committee record concerns 18/02013/FUL for 1,089 dwellings and granted conditional permission subject to Mayor referral, amendments up to decision notice and completion of a Section 106 agreement.
The 7 January 2020 permission date is retained separately from the June 2019 Committee resolution.
21/02087/VAR described a Section 73 variation increasing residential units by 29 from the original 1,089, subject to a deed-of-variation legal agreement and delegated finality.
23/01915/VAR described a further 56 units, from 1,118 to 1,164, with delegated authority subject to legal-agreement completion or extension/refusal action.
The +29 and +56 variation narratives are successive revisions and are not added mechanically to the current Brownfield figure of 1,089.
No exact current consolidated decision notice, executed variation chain, HMLR title topology or statutory overlay bundle was verified this wave.

examples.result: DP remains a current 1,089-home permissioned Brownfield record.
The June 2019 Committee resolution is kept separate from the 7 January 2020 permission date.
The 2022 +29 variation is not added blindly to 1,089.
The 2024 +56 variation is treated as a later revision from 1,118 to 1,164, not a second additive scheme.
Delegated approval subject to legal agreement is not represented as an independently verified issued-final decision.
Development commenced does not prove every later variation is operative.
The Brownfield point and ownership category are not converted into title geometry or proprietor identity.
Promotion remains zero until the consolidated legal-consent chain, title relation and overlays are verified.
